Job Description

In this hands-on position with the European Customer Analytical Services - Technology Centre of Excellence, you will perform root cause investigations into metallurgical failures and assess corrosion mechanisms. Serving clients throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, you will analyze samples from hydrocarbon process and water treatment operations-such as petroleum refineries, cooling towers, heat exchangers, and boilers. Your expertise in metallurgy and failure analysis will directly drive critical materials and reliability decisions across water and hydrocarbon process systems.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Conduct comprehensive metallurgical failure analyses and corrosion mechanism assessments, gathering necessary process information and determining required analytical approaches to determine root causes of failures in industrial water and hydrocarbon process systems

• 
Act as the technical go-to for metallurgical evaluations and materials selection, providing consulting support across the organization

• 
Operate the Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM-EDXA) and other analytical instrumentation to support metallurgical examinations

• 
Execute failure analysis investigations on membrane systems (reverse osmosis, ultra-/nanfiltration membranes, flat sheet and spiral wound, as well as hollow fibre configurations), delivering clear findings and recommendations

• 
Collaborate with other laboratory departments (organic analyses, microbiological examinations, etc.) to gather comprehensive analytical data

• 
Prepare detailed, professional analytical reports and provide high-level technical input to Technology and Commercial teams

• 
Deliver work on schedule in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while maintaining compliance with all EHS policies and procedures

• 
Take ownership of customer application and R&D projects on membrane systems, including planning, execution, and reporting
Qualifications
Required Qualifications

• 
Master's degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science & Engineering, or equivalent professional experience

• 
Minimum 3 years of metallurgical laboratory experience, including leading failure analysis investigations (academic and/or industrial/commercial)

• 
Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills suitable for all organizational levels

• 
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

• 
Strong computer proficiency and comfort working in a high-volume environment

• 
Demonstrated ability to lead projects and manage priorities

• 
Fluency in English

• 
Pro-active behavior and professional reporting to customers

• 
Excellent problem-solving capability

Preferred Qualifications

• 
Hands-on experience with tools and instrumentation such as: digital photography, saws/cut-off wheels, cleaning equipment, hardness testing, metallographic microscopes, SEM-EDXA, stereomicroscopes, micrometers, sample preparation equipment, and related hand tools

• 
Experience using LabWare LIMS

• 
Knowledge of industrial water treatment processes and experience performing failure analyses tied to industrial water or process systems

• 
General programming knowledge

CLdN is a leading provider of integrated quay-to-quay and door-to-door logistics solutions. Founded in 1929, CLdN ensures reliable, cost-effective transport that links the major economic areas of Europe. With 30 ships and more than 200 sailings a week, CLdN provides shortsea connections between the European continent, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Iberia and Scandinavia and offers the lowest CO2 footprint of all Western European RoRo operators. At 
World of Tents in Ronse, we design, develop and supply shelter solutions and crisis response equipment for organisations operating in some of the world's most demanding environments.
 

Our brands 
ALPINTER and SHIELD, support humanitarian organisations, governments, defence and emergency response teams with reliable products designed to perform when it matters most. To strengthen our Quality team, we are looking for a QHSE Specialist who combines an eye for detail with a hands-on mindset and a passion for continuous improvement in product and performance.
 

WHAT WILL YOU DO? 
As our Quality Management Officer, you contribute to the appropriate quality and reliability of our products, from raw materials to finished solutions. Working closely with our QHSE Manager, WOT Teams, international suppliers and external specialist stakeholders, you combine 
quality management processes, QA/QC coordination with our manufacturing partners and product testing, in a practical & problem-solving manner.
 

Here's where you will make a difference:
 

1. Quality Management & compliance
 
 

• Maintain and improve our Quality Management Systems (QMS), supporting ISO 9001 & 14001 compliance, internal & external audits and QA/QC procedures. 

• Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, product quality and sustainability. 

• Support Product Development and Supply Chain colleagues in Quality related aspects of their work  

2. Product Quality & Testing
 
 

• Define quality requirements and testing procedures for raw materials and finished products,  

• Coordinate product testing for core items such as tents, core relief items and other shelter-related equipment, together with internal teams and external laboratories. 

• Analyse test results, identify risks and translate findings into practical improvements.  

3. Customer & Supplier Quality
 
 

• Ensure our products meet customer specifications and quality expectations. 

• Investigate quality complaints, identify root causes and coordinate corrective actions with the teams involved. 

• Monitor incoming goods and supplier quality, following up on inspection reports and quality issues.  

4. Processes & Sustainability
 
 

• Develop, review and audit standard operating procedures and production controls. 

• Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, consistency and sustainability in collaboration with the QHSE Manager.  

You work closely with our Quality Officer, who provides practical support during product inspections and testing, and report directly to the QHSE Manager.
 

READY TO MAKE YOUR QUALITIES COUNT?
 

We'd love to hear from you! Send your CV to jobs@wot.group.

WHAT QUALITIES ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
 

We are looking for someone who combines 
technical knowledge with a practical, solution-oriented approach.
 
 

• A degree in Textile Technology, Quality Management, Engineering or a related technical field, or min 3 years of equivalent experience. 

• Experience in respect to quality control processes; experience with ISO 9001/14001 or Quality Management Systems is a plus. 

• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to turn findings into clear reports and improvements. 

• Comfortable working with MS Office and Data Management systems 

• Fluent in English; Dutch and/or French are an advantage. 

• Experience with textiles, technical fabrics and/or product testing is a plus.  

And just as importantly, you:
 
 

• Are analytical, accurate and looking for solutions 

• Enjoy hands-on work and practical result driven approach 

• Take ownership and work independently. 

• Communicate easily and enjoy collaborating with different teams. 

• Are curious, proactive and eager to learn.
